items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses

items.claim: Aaron was to take his rod

items.quote: stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water
items.claim: Aaron was to stretch out his hand over the waters of Egypt
items.place: waters of Egypt, streams, rivers, ponds, pools of water

items.quote: that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone
items.claim: The waters would become blood throughout Egypt and in vessels
